description: Source code for mod_ajp13, an implementation of the Apache JServ Protocol 1.3 (AJP13) gateway for the lighttpd web server. Contains functions for protocol handling, request creation, header encoding/decoding, and plugin initialization.

methods.name: mod_ajp13_merge_config_cpv
methods.description: Merges individual plugin configuration values into the plugin config structure.

methods.name: mod_ajp13_merge_config
methods.description: Merges multiple plugin configuration values into the plugin config structure.

methods.name: mod_ajp13_patch_config
methods.description: Applies configuration patches to the plugin config based on request and global defaults.

methods.name: mod_ajp13_set_defaults
methods.description: Initializes default configuration values for the mod_ajp13 plugin.

methods.name: ajp13_dec_uint16
methods.description: Decodes a 16-bit unsigned integer from a byte array in network byte order.

methods.name: ajp13_enc_uint16_nc
methods.description: Encodes a 16-bit unsigned integer into a byte array in network byte order without bounds checking.

methods.name: ajp13_enc_uint16
methods.description: Encodes a 16-bit unsigned integer into a buffer, returns new offset.

methods.name: ajp13_enc_byte
methods.description: Encodes a single byte into a buffer, returns new offset.

methods.name: ajp13_enc_string
methods.description: Encodes a string with length prefix into a buffer, handling special cases for empty and maximum length.

methods.name: ajp13_stdin_append
methods.description: Appends request body data to the backend in AJP13 packet format.

methods.name: ajp13_stdin_append_n
methods.description: Appends a specified number of bytes of request body data, or an empty packet if none.

methods.name: ajp13_method_byte
methods.description: Maps HTTP method to AJP13 method byte.

methods.name: ajp13_enc_request_headers
methods.description: Encodes HTTP request headers into AJP13 format.

methods.name: ajp13_enc_attribute
methods.description: Encodes a request attribute into AJP13 format.

methods.name: ajp13_enc_attributes
methods.description: Encodes common request attributes into AJP13 format.

methods.name: ajp13_enc_server_name
methods.description: Encodes server name into AJP13 format.

methods.name: ajp13_create_env
methods.description: Creates AJP13 environment headers for backend request.

methods.name: ajp13_expand_headers
methods.description: Expands AJP13 headers packet into HTTP headers buffer.

methods.name: mod_ajp13_plugin_init
methods.description: Initializes the mod_ajp13 plugin, setting function pointers and plugin info.
